add_common_cli_args: add CLI arguments for SimCLR sender, shared vision, loss type, checkpoint path, and pdb to an argparse parser
get_params: build an argparse Namespace with fixed and configurable parameters for the EmCom SSL game including random seed initialization
get_game: build a game module from params and load its state dict from a checkpoint file path
save_interaction: save an Interaction object to a Torch pickle file in the specified log directory path
get_dataloader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from an ImageFolder dataset with configurable image size, batch size, and augmentations
